Hi Maya,

We're compiling evidence for our upcoming SOC 2 audit and need the most recent penetration test report that covers Redwood's Hosted API environment. Can you confirm: 1) the date/scope of the most recent test and whether Hosted API (public endpoints, auth, token handling) is in-scope; 2) whether the report contains customer-identifiable data that will require redaction; and 3) your preferred secure transfer method (we can accept S3 presigned URL, an encrypted ZIP, or access to a short-lived review portal).

We can sign an NDA if you require it — happy to use DocuSign. Ideally we'd receive the report within 3 business days to keep our evidence collection on schedule.

Hi Mike / Acme security team —

Thanks for the request. Short answers up front: yes, Hosted API endpoints were included in our January 2026 penetration test; we can provide the full internal report under NDA; and our preferred transfer is a time-limited, pre-signed S3 link with a secondary AES-256 encrypted ZIP for an extra layer of protection (we exchange the key out-of-band).

Next steps I propose:
- I will send a standard mutual NDA via DocuSign (link below) — once countersigned we will generate the secure package.
- Security will prepare a redaction checklist (we redact any customer-identifying PII that belongs to third parties). For audit teams we typically deliver the full report with redaction notes appended, not a heavily redacted executive summary.
- Transfer options: presigned S3 (72h expiry) + password-encrypted ZIP (key via direct phone or a separate email to a dedicated contact); or we can create a 7-day review session in our Evidence Vault (requires temporary account).

I've attached a short PT summary and our sharing playbook to illustrate the process. Looping in Irene (security lead) and Dylan (infra) to coordinate the presigned link and the transfer.

DocuSign NDA: https://app.docusign.com/secure/sign/ABC123

If you can confirm: 1) whether you will sign the NDA, and 2) who should receive the presigned link (email address for the transfer) we can turn on the package tonight.

Best,

Following up with operational details from Security & Infra:

1) Report access policy: We will only release the full pen test report after a countersigned mutual NDA has been received. For customers doing SOC 2 work we can include a short attestation that the Hosted API was in-scope and list the testing windows and high-level coverage.

2) Redaction approach: The vendor (internal testing lab) redacted any unrelated third-party customer PII prior to delivery. We will re-check and provide a signed redaction checklist. (Attached: signed_redaction_checklist_2026.pdf)

3) Transfer mechanics (preferred order):
   - Option A (preferred): Create an S3 presigned GET link valid for 72 hours. Deliver link to the designated recipient + create AES-256 ZIP; we will communicate the ZIP password via a separate channel (phone or separate email).

   - Option C (less preferred): Encrypted attachment via DocuSign or partner portal.

4) Timeline: once NDA is countersigned we can generate the S3 presigned link within 6 business hours.

Dylan, if you can prepare the presigned URL after we confirm NDA and recipient email, I'll schedule the ZIP encryption and key handoff.
